column5: The configured LIMIT-only source owns a typed offset/count stream with exact source-close accounting; Go session contexts, chunks, inline projection, and memory trackers remain open.

LIMIT 0 is a typed local empty result before capacity/key validation or source consumption; otherwise configured TopN validates each signed-BIGINT row before bounded max-heap admission, retains at most checked offset plus count candidates, applies a canonical final order and source-ordinal ties, and never full-materializes input; Go chunks, spill, workers, rank TopN, failpoints, and executor lifecycle remain open.
One local max-heap evicts only its current worst candidate and retains stable source ordinals; chunk row pointers, compaction, memory tracking, and spill ownership remain open.
This single-threaded bounded owner has no worker or channel path; candidate comparison is canonical and bounded while Go parallel/spill worker coordination remains explicit.
